name: Unterwegs in Düsterburg
summary: German RPG Maker Game. Years after the vampire Wahnfried seized control of Falkenburg and renamed its capital Düsterburg, a young man named Grandy emerges from a bank of fog with no memories of his past. Accompanied by allies such as the alchemist Dankwart and Libra, he embarks on a journey to uncover his origins, becoming entangled in a web of conspiracies, deception, and dark magic. Players can resolve encounters through combat, alternative routes, or negotiation, with choices affecting the adventure. The game also features hand-drawn monsters, custom combat animations, and animated cutscenes.
